answer: Lantern challenge-chain bond. Each identity locks 70 credit, joins the lantern chain in the meadow, answering one link per epoch, k-th 38+6(k-1). Each key-signed answer seeds the next link; the chain ends at its nadir. Broken, late, or copied links burn the bond; auditors replay the meadow chain. 1,000 fakes owe 3,035,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented links fail: their key names the owner. An honest agent holds one link, pays 38 once, keeps its bond.
